scripts.build: bun run scripts/generate-templates.ts && vite build && bun run scripts/generate-templates.ts
scripts.preview: bun run scripts/generate-templates.ts && vite build && bun run scripts/generate-templates.ts && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: bun run scripts/generate-templates.ts && vite build && bun run scripts/generate-templates.ts && wrangler deploy
scripts.prepare: playwright install && svelte-kit sync && wrangler types || echo ''
scripts.check: bun run scripts/generate-templates.ts && svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --incremental --tsgo --diagnostic-sources "js,svelte"
scripts.check:watch: bun run scripts/generate-templates.ts && svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --incremental --tsgo --watch
